annotations.title: Recent SEC Form D Filings (Venture and Tech)

description: Lists recent SEC Form D filings (private offerings notices, public EDGAR data) from venture funds and technology companies over the last few filing days, with issuer, amount sold, related persons and the EDGAR link for each filing. A Form D is a notice a company or fund files after it starts selling securities. It is not a funding announcement and the amounts are as self-reported. Returns "dataset not available yet" until Mode VC has loaded the data.

industry_group.description: Industry group as filed, e.g. "Pooled Investment Fund", "Other Technology", "Computers".

min_amount_sold.description: Only filings with at least this total amount sold, in USD.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the issuer name or a related person name.
